shortDescription: Create/Delete Bare Metal Resources from OpenStack

options.name: api_timeout
options.description: How long should the socket layer wait before timing out for API calls. If this is omitted, nothing will be passed to the requests library.

options.name: auth
options.description: Dictionary containing auth information as needed by the cloud's auth plugin strategy. For the default I(password) plugin, this would contain I(auth_url), I(username), I(password), I(project_name) and any information about domains (for example, I(user_domain_name) or I(project_domain_name)) if the cloud supports them. For other plugins, this param will need to contain whatever parameters that auth plugin requires. This parameter is not needed if a named cloud is provided or OpenStack OS_* environ

options.name: auth_type
options.description: Name of the auth plugin to use. If the cloud uses something other than password authentication, the name of the plugin should be indicated here and the contents of the I(auth) parameter should be updated accordingly.

options.name: bios_interface
options.description: The bios interface for this node, e.g. C(no-bios).

options.name: boot_interface
options.description: The boot interface for this node, e.g. C(pxe).

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: A path to a CA Cert bundle that can be used as part of verifying SSL API requests.

options.name: chassis_id
options.description: Associate the node with a pre-defined chassis.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: A path to a client certificate to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: client_key
options.description: A path to a client key to use as part of the SSL transaction.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Named cloud or cloud config to operate against. If I(cloud) is a string, it references a named cloud config as defined in an OpenStack clouds.yaml file. Provides default values for I(auth) and I(auth_type). This parameter is not needed if I(auth) is provided or if OpenStack OS_* environment variables are present. If I(cloud) is a dict, it contains a complete cloud configuration like would be in a section of clouds.yaml.

options.name: console_interface
options.description: The console interface for this node, e.g. C(no-console).

options.name: deploy_interface
options.description: The deploy interface for this node, e.g. C(iscsi).

options.name: driver
options.description: The name of the Ironic Driver to use with this node. Required when I(state) is C(present)

options.name: driver_info
options.description: Information for this node's driver. Will vary based on which driver is in use. Any sub-field which is populated will be validated during creation. For compatibility reasons sub-fields `power`, `deploy`, `management` and `console` are flattened.

options.name: id
options.description: ID to be given to the baremetal node. Will be auto-generated on creation if not specified, and I(name) is specified. Definition of I(id) will always take precedence over I(name).

options.name: inspect_interface
options.description: The interface used for node inspection, e.g. C(no-inspect).

options.name: interface
options.description: Endpoint URL type to fetch from the service catalog.

options.name: management_interface
options.description: The interface for out-of-band management of this node, e.g. "ipmitool".

options.name: name
options.description: unique name identifier to be given to the resource.

options.name: network_interface
options.description: The network interface provider to use when describing connections for this node.

options.name: nics
options.description: A list of network interface cards, eg, C( - mac: aa:bb:cc:aa:bb:cc) This node attribute cannot be updated.

options.name: power_interface
options.description: The interface used to manage power actions on this node, e.g. C(ipmitool).

options.name: properties
options.description: Definition of the physical characteristics of this node Used for scheduling purposes

options.name: raid_interface
options.description: Interface used for configuring raid on this node.

options.name: region_name
options.description: Name of the region.

options.name: rescue_interface
options.description: Interface used for node rescue, e.g. C(no-rescue).

options.name: resource_class
options.description: The specific resource type to which this node belongs.

options.name: sdk_log_level
options.description: Log level of the OpenStackSDK

options.name: sdk_log_path
options.description: Path to the logfile of the OpenStackSDK. If empty no log is written

options.name: skip_update_of_masked_password
options.description: Deprecated, no longer used. Updating or specifing a password has not been supported for a while.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates desired state of the resource

options.name: storage_interface
options.description: Interface used for attaching and detaching volumes on this node, e.g. C(cinder).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Number of seconds to wait for the newly created node to reach the available state.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not SSL API requests should be verified. Before Ansible 2.3 this defaulted to C(true).

options.name: vendor_interface
options.description: Interface for all vendor-specific actions on this node, e.g. C(no-vendor).

options.name: wait
options.description: Should ansible wait until the requested resource is complete.
